paragraphs.text: He calls to those who partly for fear, and partly for their own case, remained still in captivity, and so preferred their own personal benefits to the benefits of God promised in his Church.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: As it was I that scattered you, so I have power to restore you.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: By fleeing from Babylon, and coming to the Church.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: Seeing that God had begun to show his grace among you by delivering you, he continues the same still toward you, and therefore sends me his angel and his Christ to defend you from your enemies, so that they will not hurt you, neither along the way nor at home.

paragraphs.text: You are so dear to God, that he can no more allow your enemies to hurt you, than a man can endure to be thrust in the eye; Ps 17:8.
